title: Authorize caller-selected model and provider overrides
description:
Problem: request fields can select a model or provider independently of the caller's configured profile, so a caller may bypass intended model/provider allowlists or route work to a more privileged or higher-cost backend.

Desired outcome: caller-selected overrides are permitted only when the resolved principal and profile explicitly authorize them.

Scope:
- Define the policy for fixed-profile, allowlisted, and administrator override modes.
- Validate provider/model pairs against the active profile before invocation.
- Reject unknown, unavailable, disallowed, or cross-profile combinations without contacting the provider.
- Record the effective provider/model and policy decision without recording secrets or prompt content.
- Add compatibility behavior for existing clients that omit overrides.
- Out of scope: provider credential loading and provider adapter normalization.

Acceptance criteria:
- Default callers use the configured profile and cannot bypass it through request fields.
- Authorized callers can select only allowlisted provider/model pairs.
- Disallowed overrides fail with a stable client-safe response and no provider call.
- Tests cover omitted, valid, invalid, unavailable, and unauthorized overrides across API and agent-session paths.
- Documentation and request schemas state the override policy.

Validation:
- Run focused model-selection, agent-session, and authorization tests.
- Run the application build.
- Run Test-TaskRecords.ps1 after task metadata changes.
